Fiona the hippo dies after swallowing a hat at Cincinnati Zoo
- Published
The Cincinnati Zoo in Ohio says its beloved hippopotamus Fiona has died just days after swallowing a knit hat that slipped into her enclosure.
"It is with extreme sadness that we share with you the devastating news that Fiona did not make it after multiple attempts from our amazing vets and keeper team to help her through what ended up being a medical emergency," the zoo said on Thursday afternoon.
Fiona swallowed the hat about 10 days ago and was asymptomatic at first but then required emergency care.
The vet staff "tried everything they could to help her" but "despite multiple attempts to move the hat out of her system, it was ultimately too much to overcome", the zoo said.
"We are in shock at the moment," Cincinnati Zoo director Dave Jenike said in a statement. "We did not expect this outcome. She fought until she couldn't anymore."
Michelle Curley, a spokesperson for the zoo, had said that the hat got into Fiona's enclosure by accident, after a visitor tossed it in the air and it caught on a ceiling fan that flung it through a small opening.
"We probably couldn't make [it] happen again if we tried," Curley said.
While she seemed fine at first, her appetite started to decrease a few days later, and the zoo staff tried to encourage Fiona to eat to help push the hat through her digestive system.
An ultrasound before her death showed the hat passing through Fiona's small intestine. A zookeeper said that surgery was not an option for full-grown hippos and "our best chance for success with Fiona would be if she could pass this on her own".
"Our animal care team was heroic in their efforts to save her. They did everything possible, but her body couldn't fight anymore," Jenike said.
Fiona was born premature at the Cincinnati Zoo in 2017 and at first struggled to survive. At birth, she weighed 13 kg (29 lbs), which the zoo said was about half the previous lowest recorded birth weight for her species.
Her story inspired an ice cream flavour as well as a character in Cincinnati's ballet.

היפופוטמית המחמד פיונה מתה בגן החיות בסינסינטי שבאוהיו, ימים ספורים לאחר שבלעה כובע סרוג שנפל לתוך המתחם שלה. מבקר במקום השליק את הכובע באוויר והוא נתפס במאוורר תקרה שהעיף אותו דרך פתח קטן. פיונה בתחילה לא הפגינה תסמינים, אך בהמשך איבדה את התיאבון, וצוות הווטרינרים ניסה לסייע לה להעביר את הכובע במערכת העיכול.

למרות בדיקות אולטרסאונד שהראו התקדמות של הכובע במעי הדק, מצבה החמיר והיא לא שרדה את חירום רפואי זה. מנהל גן החיות ציין כי הצוות עשה הכול כדי להצילה, אך גופה לא היה יכול להילחם עוד. פיונה נולדה פגה ב-2017 במשקל זעיר של 13 קילוגרמים וזכתה לפרסום רב, ואף היוותה השראה לטעם גלידה ולדמות בבלט המקומי.
